data.name: Abzari
data.gender_notes: Abzari is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who possesses wisdom, intelligence, and power. The name Abzari carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Abzari usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual guide, a wise and powerful soul.
data.etymology: Abzari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abzari total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: أبزاري
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من أبزار، يعني المزين أو الممتع
in_arabic.long_meaning: أبزاري هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ب-ز-ر' والذي يعني الزينة أو التمتع. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يمتلك قدرة على إضافة الجمال أو الفرح إلى حياة الآخرين. ويرتبط هذا الاسم بصفات مثل الإبداع والجمال والتفاؤل.

in_urdu.name: ابزاری
in_urdu.meaning: ابزاری کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت یا مزید خوش کن
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابزاری ایک عربی ಮೂಲ کا نام ہے جو 'ب-ز-ر' جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے زینت یا خوشی. جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان روایت میں، یہ نام ان شخصیات کے ساتھ وابستہ ہے جو زندگی میں خوبصورتی اور تروتازگی لاتے ہیں. اس نام کے حاملین میں تخلیقی صلاحیت، جمال اور خوش دلفتی جیسی صفات پائی جاتی ہیں.

in_hindi.name: अबज़ारी
in_hindi.meaning: अबज़ारी का अर्थ है सुंदर या अधिक आनंददायक
in_hindi.long_meaning: अबज़ारी एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जो 'ब-ज़-र' जड़ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अलंकार या खुशी. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों से जुड़ा हुआ है जो जीवन में सौंदर्य और ताजगी लाते हैं. इस नाम के धारियों में रचनात्मकता, सौंदर्य और हर्ष जैसे गुण पाए जाते हैं.

in_pashto.name: ابزاري
in_pashto.meaning: ابزاري د ښکلا یا ډیر خوښۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ابزاري د عربي ريښې څخه يو نوم دی چې 'ب-ز-ر' څخه مشتق شوی دی، کوم چې د ښکلا یا خوښۍ معنی لري. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو سره تړلی دی چې په ژوند کې ښکلا او تازګي راوړي. د دې نوم د لرونکو په کې خلاقيت، ښکلا او خوشحالي ځانګړتیاوې ليدل کيږي.

in_english.name: Abzari
in_english.meaning: Abzari means beautiful or highly enjoyable and entertaining
in_english.long_meaning: Abzari is derived from the Arabic root 'b-z-r', which signifies adornment or joy. In Islamic tradition, the name Abzari is associated with individuals who bring beauty, happiness, and refreshment to the lives of others. The name connotes qualities such as creativity, aesthetics, and optimism. Historically, names derived from this root have been used to express positive attributes and aspirations for the individual bearing the name.

data.cultural_impact: The name Abzari is Persian in origin, derived from the Persian language 'Ab' meaning 'father of' and 'Zari' meaning 'wise' or 'intelligent'. Historically, names in Persian culture hold great significance and often reflect the status, qualities, and achievements of the individual. Abzari, as a name, suggests a person who is wise, intelligent, and powerful, and as such, would have been held in high esteem in Persian society.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, wisdom and intelligence are considered essential qualities for spiritual growth and development. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "The seeking of knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim." (Sahih Bukhari). The name Abzari, rooted in the idea of wisdom and intelligence, carries with it a spiritual significance in the Islamic context. It encourages the bearer of the name to seek knowledge, wisdom, and understanding, not only for personal growth but also to contribute positively to the community and the wider world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Wise, Intelligent, Powerful" symbolizes A person who possesses wisdom, intelligence, and power.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Abzari serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of wise, intelligent, powerful.
